verbatim_quote.original: ببین، اگر همه اطلاعات رو داری و کامند و داکیومنت و هر چیزی که داری دقیقه، آپ تو دیته، اوکیه. منم قبول دارم. کار رو انجام بده، بعد داکیومنت‌های پروژه رو هم آپدیت کن.
verbatim_quote.english_translation: Look, if all the information, commands, documents, everything you have is precise and up to date, fine. I agree. Do the work, then update the project docs too.

extracted_decision.summary: Exit node routes only TCP peer traffic through the Psiphon US tunnel; QUIC (UDP/443) is dropped to force browser fallback to TCP; all other UDP (DNS, VoIP, Telegram/WhatsApp calls) exits directly from the server.
extracted_decision.rationale: Manager wanted a US IP for browser/TCP traffic without breaking UDP services; dropping QUIC prevents direct-IP leaks while keeping calls and DNS working at the exit node.
alternatives: Tunnel all traffic including UDP through Psiphon
Chain Psiphon with WARP/usque for UDP support
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: UDP traffic carries the server's own country instead of US; first page loads may be slightly slower during QUIC-to-TCP fallback.
